mutations.before: In 4/8 dogs receiving 200 mg, and 1/8 dogs receiving 60 mg, gliosis was observed at 24 hours post-dose, but this was not associated with any necrosis or degeneration except focally at the injection site in 1 animal at the 200 mg dose. No gliosis was observed at the 28 day post-dose recovery timepoint. The gliosis was classified as non-adverse by the pathologists. No gliosis or other pathological findings were observed in rat.
mutations.after: No test article-related microscopic findings were observed in rats or dogs.
